description: This file contains Chinese localization strings for the Select2 plugin version 4.0.6-rc.1, defining messages for various user interface scenarios such as loading results, input length restrictions, and selection limits.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns message when results fail to load.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns message indicating how many characters to delete when input exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns message indicating how many characters to input when input is below minimum length.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns message indicating that a search is in progress.
